name: godot-gdscript
status_note: Extracted from two real Godot projects' working docs and CI. The conventions are rules that came out of real bugs; the CI steps ran in those projects' CI. This module itself has not yet been rendered through a fresh bootstrap run.

cross_platform_habits.when: on by default for games (macOS, Linux and Windows are all supported targets); opt out only for a deliberately single-platform project

translatable_text.when: on by default for games (cheaper to start translatable than to retrofit); opt out only if the game will never be localized

run_commands: Import / script-error check: .godot-bin/godot --headless --editor --quit (then fail on SCRIPT ERROR)
